high_level_description: This image appears to be a social media post from an Instagram account named "mapster_17," which is located in North Korea, Pyongyang. The post is titled "IQ OF NORTH KOREA COMPARED TO THE WORLD." It features a world map with different shades of green representing countries based on their IQ scores compared to North Korea. The map is divided into three categories: Countries having higher IQ than North Korea (represented by a darker shade of green). Countries having lower IQ than North Korea (represented by a lighter shade of green). North Korea itself (represented by a gray color).
